2609.05404.title: Diffusion TV: Experiencing Diffusion Models through Tangible, Embodied Interaction
2609.05404.paper_summary: Diffusion TV is an interactive AI art installation that offers a tangible and embodied experience of diffusion models through a modified CRT TV. By physically manipulating the TV's antenna, audiences control the clarity of AI-generated images and sounds, metaphorically enacting the denoising process that underlies diffusion-based generation. Using the tuning knob, participants switch between three channels featuring AI-generated animals from the Past (extinct species), Present (endangered species), and Future (speculative creatures), situating the interaction within a temporal and ecological narrative. Through continuous audiovisual feedback and physical interaction, Diffusion TV foregrounds the generative process over final outputs, allowing audiences to explore intermediate states as experiential material. Rather than providing explicit technical explanation, the work presents an alternative, embodied mode of explainable AI that invites exploratory engagement with and reflection on generative technologies.
2609.05404.paper_summary_zh: 擴散電視是一個互動式的人工智慧藝術裝置，通過改裝的CRT電視提供了擴散模型的具體和具身體的體驗。<lb/>通過物理操作電視的天線，觀眾可以控制人工智慧生成的圖像和聲音的清晰度，隱喻性地執行基於擴散的生成過程中的去噪過程。<lb/>使用調諧旋鈕，參與者可以在三個頻道之間切換，這些頻道展示了來自過去（滅絕物種）、現在（瀕危物種）和未來（推測生物）的人工智慧生成動物，將互動置於時間和生態敘事之中。<lb/>通過持續的視聽反饋和物理互動，擴散電視將生成過程置於最前面，而非最終輸出，讓觀眾探索中間狀態作為體驗材料。<lb/>這個作品並未提供明確的技術解釋，而是呈現了一種替代的、具身體的可解釋人工智慧模式，邀請人們對生成技術進行探索性參與和反思。
